//: The geoAtt mark: a fingerprint, as nested arcs. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY DEFINITION of the geometry. lib/logo-geometry.ts reads it to draw animated SVG; tools/generate-assets.mjs reads it to rasterise the PNGs. Those two implement different algorithms (arc paths vs signed distance fields) and always will, but the numbers must never diverge — when they did, the native splash visibly jumped as it handed over to the animated one.
//space: Unit space: the plate is a circle of radius 0.5 centred on (0.5, 0.5). Angles are degrees in SVG convention — 0 points right, increasing clockwise, so 270 is straight up. Every ridge opens downward (roughly 180 through 360), which is what makes the stack read as a fingerprint rather than concentric circles.
//uneven: The spans are deliberately uneven. Equal ones read as a machine-drawn target; widening each outer ridge a little more than the last suggests a print. The last two are short fragments, one per side, because real ridges do not all survive to the edge.
//center: Arcs are centred on (cx, cy), NOT on the plate's own centre (0.5, 0.5). The ridges only sweep the upper ~216 degrees of the circle (see //space), so a mark centred on 0.5 has its visual mass sitting well above the middle — measured, the bounding box was y 0.055..0.617, centring at 0.336, leaving the bottom third of the plate empty on the full-bleed store icon. Lowering cy to 0.664 recentres that box on 0.5. This matches how most real fingerprint icons are drawn anyway: the core sits in the lower-middle, not dead centre.
